exploreUrl:
<js>
function styles(so) {
    var today = new Date();
    var dateT = today.getFullYear()
        + '-'
        + (today.getMonth() + 1)
        + '-'
        + today.getDate()
        + '_discover_tabs';

    var url = Api('/api/discover/tabs');
    var res = null;
    var cacheData = '';
    var sourceItem = null;
    var result = [];
    var tab;
    var count = 0;
    var i;
    var u;

    try {
        cacheData = cache.get(dateT)+"1";

        if (cacheData) {
            try {
                res = JSON.parse(cacheData);
            } catch (e) {
                res = null;
            }
        }

        if (!res) {
            res = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url));

            if (res && res.code == 0) {
                cache.put(dateT, JSON.stringify(res));
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        return [{
            title: '数据加载失败，请刷新后重试',
            url: '',
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];
    }

    if (!res || res.code != 0 || !res.data || !res.data.sources) {
        return [{
            title: '请先登陆，登陆后刷新发现页即可',
            url: '',
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];
    }

    for (i = 0; i < res.data.sources.length; i++) {
        if (res.data.sources[i] && res.data.sources[i].name == so) {
            sourceItem = res.data.sources[i];
            break;
        }
    }

    if (!sourceItem || !sourceItem.tabs || sourceItem.tabs.length == 0) {
        return [{
            title: '暂无' + (so || '') + '发现内容',
            url: '',
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];
    }

    for (i = 0; i < sourceItem.tabs.length; i++) {
        tab = sourceItem.tabs[i];

        if (!tab) {
            continue;
        }

        if (tab.section) {
            if (count > 0) {
                while (count < 3) {
                    result.push({
                        title: '--',
                        url: '',
                        style: {
                            layout_flexGrow: 1,
                            layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.25
                        }
                    });
                    count++;
                }
            }

            result.push({
                title: tab.title || '',
                url: '',
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
                }
            });

            count = 0;
            continue;
        }

        u = '/api/discover/content?source='
            + encodeURIComponent(sourceItem.source || '')
            + '&tab='
            + encodeURIComponent(tab.key || '')
            + '&page={{page}}&page_size=12';

        result.push({
            title: tab.title || '',
            url: Api(u),
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.25
            }
        });

        count++;

        if (count >= 3) {
            count = 0;
        }
    }

    if (count > 0) {
        while (count < 3) {
            result.push({
                title: '--',
                url: '',
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.25
                }
            });

            count++;
        }
    }

    return result;
}

var so = cache.get('sources') || '起点小说';

var s = [
    create(
        "请选择平台",
        ["番茄小说", "七猫小说", "书旗小说", "塔读小说","红烛故事","西瓜小说","轻小说","星星短剧","依依短剧","起点小说"],
        so,
        "sources",
        1
    )
];



JSON.stringify(s.concat(styles(so)), null, 2);
</js>

<js>

var typeM = {
	"novel" : "小说",
	"audio" : "听书",
	"image" : "漫画",
	"video" : "短剧"
	};

var bookSource = result.data.source;

var latest_update_time = result.data.latest_update_time;
var description = result.data.description;
var sourceType = result.data.type;

  '  源站：' + bookSource,
  latest_chapter && ('最新章节：' + latest_chapter),
  latest_update_time && ('更新时间：' + formatDate(latest_update_time)),
  '类型：' + (typeM[sourceType] || '小说'),
  "\n",
  description
].filter(Boolean).join('\n')
</js>

ruleContent.content:
<js>
var url = java.hexDecodeToString(result);
java.log(url);
result = java.ajax(Api(url));
result = JSON.parse(result);

var content;
var code = result.code;
var msg = result.message;

var m = url ? url.match(/type=([^&]+)/) : null;
var sourceType = m ? m[1] : 'novel';

if (code != 0) {
  content = msg;
} else if (sourceType && sourceType=="novel") {
  content = Content(result);
} else {
	content = result.data.content;
}
content
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var url = java.hexDecodeToString(result);
var resStr = java.ajax(Api(url));
var res = JSON.parse(resStr);
var m = url ? url.match(/type=([^&]+)/) : null;
var sourceType = m ? m[1] : 'novel';
java.put('sourceType',sourceType);

if (res.code != 0) {
  var parts = book.bookUrl.split(',')[1];
  var decodedUrl = java.base64Decode(parts);
  resStr = java.ajax(Api(decodedUrl.replace('book/detail', 'book/chapters')));
}

var typeMap = {
    "novel": {
        ios: 0,
        default: 8
    },
    "audio": {
        ios: 1,
        default: 32
    },
    "image": {
        ios: 2,
        default: 64
    },
    "video": {
        ios: 3,
        default: 4
    }
};
var currentType = typeMap[sourceType] || typeMap["novel"];
if (Env()==3) {
book.type = currentType.ios;
} else {
book.type = currentType.default;
}

resStr;
</js>
